context.transcript:
Laurent, did you get the email I sent you about our meeting on Wednesday?
I'd like to meet at 11 o'clock instead of 1 so I can go to the doctor in the afternoon.
I can't connect to the Internet, but I think 11 o'clock on Wednesday should work fine.
Have you been having any issues with the Wi-Fi today?
No, I was able to connect.
Are you using the new password?
The IT department changed it this morning, Routine Security Maintenance.
I have it written down at my desk.
I'll go get it for you.

你用的是新密码吗？
IT部门今天早上更改了它，例行安全维护。
我把它写在我的桌上了。
我去帮你拿。
